overall_finding.checkpoint_contamination: No upstream biological weight is admitted, so checkpoint-corpus overlap is not the active risk. Leakage risk is created by local fitting, feature construction, query adaptation, transductive alignment, and outcome access.
overall_finding.package_artifacts: harmonypy, scvi-tools, and CellTypist are code packages, not pretrained biological states in this bundle.
overall_finding.sealed_fit_policy: No sealed feature or label may enter training, representation fitting, batch correction, alignment, prototype construction, calibration, model selection, or early stopping.

assay_native_pseudobulk.reason: The algorithm, implementation, and fitted artifact are unresolved. A future project-local implementation can become target_label_unexposed only after its fold and input receipts prove that held outcomes and held ATAC were absent.

cca.reason: No implementation or projection policy is frozen. A joint train-query CCA would expose held geometry and is not an eligible inductive state.

celltypist_baseline.biological_checkpoint: none; built-in CellTypist model files are prohibited
celltypist_baseline.reason: The package code is pinned, but every classifier must be newly fit within one donor outer fold. Query clustering or majority voting would expose held-query structure and is a separate transductive diagnostic.

harmony_logistic.reason: Package code has no biological pretraining, but its registered use lacks a frozen-reference query transform. Joint alignment is transductive even without labels.

hvg_pca_elastic_net.reason: The current project authority fits normalization, HVGs, PCA, classifier, and calibration state inside the donor outer training partition.

hvg_pca_knn.reason: The current project authority fits normalization, HVGs, PCA, neighbor reference, and donor/class weights inside the donor outer training partition.

hvg_pca_linear_svm.reason: The current project authority fits normalization, HVGs, PCA, SVM, and probability calibration inside the donor outer training partition.

hvg_pca_logistic.reason: The current project authority fits normalization, HVGs, PCA, and logistic state inside the donor outer training partition.

hvg_pca_nearest_centroid.reason: The current project authority fits normalization, HVGs, PCA, centroids, and softmax temperature inside the donor outer training partition.

mean_expression_bulk.reason: The feature, cohort transform, reference mean, output, and code are unresolved.

pca_procrustes.reason: No implementation or alignment policy is frozen. Held-query anchors or geometry would make the fit transductive.

scanvi_baseline.reason: The registered package is code only. A local SCVI plus SCANVI state must be fit in the outer training fold; official query-model training is not admitted in the current inductive contract.

scvi_baseline.reason: The registered package is code only. Both the generative representation and downstream classifier must remain outer-fold local; query-model training is not admitted in the current inductive contract.

fnih_86_liver.rule: No access or use unless openly downloadable donor-linked files pass rights, topology, endpoint, power, and contamination gates before selection lock.

gse267031.rule: Do not open stage outcomes until donor deduplication, endpoint completeness, frozen paired development variance, and prospective 80% power for the prespecified effect all pass. If they fail, no confirmatory bulk unblinding occurs.

gse289173.rule: Keep labels evaluator-only; expose the identical anonymized snRNA row universe to every locked candidate; commit prediction and artifact hashes before the single label join; never recalibrate, repair, or reselect on this holdout.

known_leakage_routes: Splitting cells, nuclei, libraries, tissues, timepoints, or modalities from one person across outer roles.
Failing to merge accession, BioProject, run, DOI, donor alias, release alias, expression fingerprint, or permitted genotype fingerprint into cohort_family_id and person_key before splitting.

Selecting genes, fitting normalization or scale parameters, choosing PCA dimension, learning latent variables, estimating centroids, selecting neighbors, or calibrating probabilities with development or withheld donors.
Treating cells or nuclei as biological replicates in inference, uncertainty, or significance tests.
Using GSE296875 histopathology fields to create MASLD, MASH, NAS, or fibrosis-stage labels that the frozen source authority does not establish.
Choosing the broad-label ontology, class merges, low-confidence rejection, class weights, thresholds, or evaluable class roster after seeing GSE289173 labels or predictions.
Training or updating scVI or scANVI on held-query counts through load_query_data or any equivalent query-adaptation path under the inductive champion lane.
Running Harmony, CCA, Procrustes, PCA, neighbors, clustering, or batch correction jointly on training and held cells and then describing the result as inductive.
Using CellTypist built-in pretrained model files or selecting among them after development outcomes; this bundle admits only fold-trained custom state.
Using CellTypist query-dependent majority voting in the inductive lane without a separate transductive label and locked policy.
Substituting the scvi-tools 0.14.6 package found in the Python 3.10 runtime for the registered scvi-tools 1.4.2 identity.
Installing a newer harmonypy, scvi-tools, CellTypist, scikit-learn, or dependency version while retaining the old model or environment identity.
Using GSE256398 or another external-development cohort as a pristine external seal after tuning on it.
Using PXD051911 as if its participants were paired to RNA cohorts, or porting RNA normalization and error assumptions to protein measurements.
Reading held-donor ATAC, using held ATAC to define the peak universe or normalization reference, or treating held ATAC absence as zero in rna_conditioned_atac.
Creating false cell-to-cell RNA-ATAC pairs in GSE244832 rather than donor-compatible summaries.
Using outcome availability, phenotype prevalence, assay coverage, or below-QC status to define a numeric zero or negative class.
Resolving the baseline-winner comparator ambiguity, power assumptions, hyperparameters, calibration, or release choice after sealed outcomes are known.
Carrying a fold-fitted state, feature map, latent model, centroid, query mapping, or calibrator into another outer fold.
Treating seeds as independent biological replicates or allowing cell count to inflate the paired bootstrap effective sample size.

transductive_controls.allowed_diagnostic: A transductive result may be registered before execution, run on development data only, labeled transductive in every table, and kept outside the sealed champion comparison.
transductive_controls.held_feature_rule: Unlabeled held features are still held data. They may be passed through a frozen predictor for inference, but may not update any weight, batch parameter, anchor, cluster, neighbor graph, transform, normalization reference, or stopping rule.
transductive_controls.prohibited_relabeling: A label-free update is not automatically inductive and is not made eligible by calling it domain adaptation, integration, or reference mapping.

celltypist_baseline.current_runtime: celltypist not present in the frozen cpu_baseline_smoke distribution inventory

harmony_logistic.current_runtime: harmonypy==0.0.10 is present in the frozen cpu_baseline_smoke distribution inventory

scvi_and_scanvi.current_runtime: The frozen classical runtime is CPython 3.10.18 and contains scvi-tools 0.14.6. The registered scvi-tools 1.4.2 requires Python >=3.11 and is not installed in that lock.
scvi_and_scanvi.identity: scvi-tools==1.4.2 at release dc95497; wheel SHA-256 c453b75b0fa0d222bf0eb3a531607d17f5ea0dbe5b848ab12fd8cc24599884e5

celltypist_baseline.weights: No upstream weights admitted. Project-generated fitted classifier release remains subject to training-data terms and project model-card review.

hvg_pca_family.code: project_owned authorities permit use and redistribution
hvg_pca_family.weights: No upstream weights. Fold-generated parameters may be released under the project authority after input-data review.

scvi_and_scanvi.weights: No upstream weights admitted. Project-generated model state requires notices, dependency audit, training-data review, and a safe-loading release path.

license_and_release_disposition.warning: An upstream package license does not settle licenses of dependencies, project adapters, input matrices, donor-derived fitted weights, or redistributed predictions.

baseline_comparator_policy.policy: Select the candidate with the strongest prospectively frozen development endpoint. Compare it with the strongest eligible prespecified baseline after excluding the selected model. A baseline may be the winner. If no distinct eligible comparator remains, make no superiority claim. Negative controls are never champions or champion baselines.

remaining_blockers: Keep the five existing HVG/PCA models limited to cell_state_mapping until a separate donor-level bulk adapter, input fixture, preprocessing authority, fitted-state contract, and runtime receipt exist.
For scVI and scANVI, create a separate Python 3.11+ environment pinned to the verified 1.4.2 wheel hash; do not substitute the installed 0.14.6 package.

Freeze scVI and scANVI gene universe, raw-count layer, covariates, architecture, head or label ontology, seeds, early stopping, calibration, and a no-held-query-training inference path; hash every fold state.

For CellTypist, freeze a locally installed 1.7.1 environment, fold-local custom training recipe, features, solver and regularization, balancing, seed, calibration, majority-vote disposition, safe loading, and fitted-state hashes; use no pretrained classifier.

Keep Harmony outside the sealed tournament unless a validated frozen-reference transform is independently registered; otherwise it remains a labeled development-only transductive diagnostic under GPL terms.

Implement PCA-Procrustes and CCA only after exact training-only alignment mathematics, anchors, feature and pairing rules, code revision, license, runtime, seeds, and prediction interface are frozen; add them to the TaskSpec roster before scheduling.
Implement mean_expression_bulk with an assay-native participant-level input, training-only cohort transform and mean, covariates, feature masks, output definition, license, environment, and hashes.

Define assay_native_pseudobulk separately for bulk transfer and RNA-conditioned ATAC. For ATAC, freeze the predictive rule and prove that no observed held ATAC, target-derived peak filter, or held normalization reference enters inference.
Activate GSE267031 only after the outcome-blind prospective 80% power gate; otherwise do not claim a bulk champion.
Treat RNA-conditioned ATAC as retrospective until an eligible public FNIH or equivalent external seal activates; no development result can become a MASLD champion.
For GSE289173, freeze identical row eligibility, label ontology, preprocessing, seeds, calibration, comparator, and predictions before the one-time evaluator join.
Retain explicit missing states and donor-level inference throughout; never encode absent assay, untestability, permission limits, unresolved joins, or withheld evidence as zero.
